test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

The class / teacher was / wounded in / a leg.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the article** "a"** before the term** "leg."**
 
• When referring to a specific part of the body, the definite article** "the" **is typically used.
 
• The correct phrase should be** "wounded in the leg,"** ensuring** grammatical correctness and clarity.**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part D** of the sentence..

**Correct Sentence:** *"The class teacher was wounded in the leg."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "The class" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **B: "teacher was" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "wounded in" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part D.
